custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 7.1 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page title reads "Part Library" and Part Library is blue in the left menu.
  • At the right of the title row: Search with a magnifier, "Manufacturer: All manufacturers" with a person icon and a down arrow, "Category: All categories" with a down arrow; the row ends there, with no button that creates an entry.
  • A header checkbox and a blue three-dot button sit before the Description header, and every row has a checkbox.
  • The columns read, in order: Description, Part Number, Tags, Category, Manufacturer, Measurement, Size.

Step 2:

  • A menu opens with Set category in it.

Step 3:

  • The menu closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S11-R1: “The Part Library page has no control that creates a Part Library entry.”
  • S11-R4: “Row selection on the Part Library list and its bulk "Set category" action stay available.”
  • S11-R5: “Search, filtering, sorting and the column set on the Part Library list stay available.”
  • S12-R1: “The Parts left menu entry reads "Part Library".”
  • S12-R2: “The page title on that screen reads "Part Library".”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
